claims.claim_text: The indexed Elbert Baldwin is the international-trade writer and publisher who joined OSS in 1944 and served as a major in Italy.
claims.evidence_excerpt: when he joined the Office of Strategic Services ... served as a major ... in Italy
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A contemporary Washington obituary gives the uncommon exact name, direct OSS entry year, major rank, Italy service, and a detailed pre-OSS chronology.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the uncommon exact name and a contemporary account explicitly naming OSS, the 1944 entry year, major rank, Italy, and distinctive international-trade career.
claims.temporal_assessment: The obituary was published in December 1947 and describes Baldwin's prewar career, wartime transition, and OSS service in direct chronological order.
claims.match_notes: Not marked confirmed because the indexed Box 31 personnel file has not been compared directly with the obituary subject.
